RISK-LOOP-PROD-AUTH-001-REDEPLOY-PENDING.containment: The corrected default and round-2 fail-closed/governed-identity/gated-deploy code only ship to the hosted dev BFF on the next 'Pantheon Nonprod Deploy' run that both includes this branch's merge SHA and has DEV_BFF_JWT_SECRET/DEV_BFF_OIDC_CLIENT_ID/DEV_BFF_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET configured (or the deploy will refuse to run at all per the new preflight gate); until then the hosted BFF continues to run permissive/stub auth, which is the pre-existing (not newly introduced) posture.
RISK-LOOP-PROD-AUTH-001-REDEPLOY-PENDING.description: Neither round-1 (scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh's corrected DEV_BFF_AUTH_STUB/DEV_BFF_AUTH_MODE defaults) nor round-2 (fail-closed auth-mode validation, governed dev-login identities, deploy credential gate) has been observed live on the hosted dev BFF as of evidence_cut_at; no Pantheon Nonprod Deploy run has occurred against this branch.
RISK-LOOP-PROD-AUTH-001-REDEPLOY-PENDING.owner: human ops (deploy approver, plus GitHub secret provisioning)
RISK-LOOP-PROD-AUTH-001-REDEPLOY-PENDING.recheck_trigger: After a Pantheon Nonprod Deploy run that includes this branch's merge SHA succeeds (i.e. passes the new credential preflight gate and assert_bff_auth_gate), re-curl GET /bff/version (expect auth_stub:false, auth_mode:strict) and GET /bff/me with an arbitrary fixed bearer (expect 401).

RISK-LOOP-PROD-AUTH-001-DEV-LOGIN-CREDEN.containment: dev-login fails closed (403 PRECONDITION_FAILED) when credentials are absent, so this gap does not create an authentication bypass. As of round 2, scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh's new preflight gate additionally refuses to run any dev deploy while DEV_BFF_AUTH_MODE=strict (the default) and these credentials are unset, so this now blocks all dev deploys, not only the distinct-identity acceptance proof.
RISK-LOOP-PROD-AUTH-001-DEV-LOGIN-CREDEN.description: Neither docker-compose.yml nor scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh provisions dev-login/JWT credentials on the hosted deploy target. .github/workflows/nonprod-deploy.yml now sources DEV_BFF_JWT_SECRET, DEV_BFF_OIDC_CLIENT_ID, and DEV_BFF_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET from repository secrets of the same name, but those three secrets have not been created in GitHub as of this evidence cut -- they must come from a secret store outside this repo and were not fabricated here. Exercising the other five identities (viewer/approver/risk_owner/operator_a/operator_b) additionally requires their own PANTHEON_BFF_DEV_LOGIN_<IDENTITY>_CLIENT_ID/_SECRET secrets, not yet provisioned either.
RISK-LOOP-PROD-AUTH-001-DEV-LOGIN-CREDEN.owner: human ops (GitHub repo/environment secret access required)
RISK-LOOP-PROD-AUTH-001-DEV-LOGIN-CREDEN.recheck_trigger: A human creates the DEV_BFF_JWT_SECRET/DEV_BFF_OIDC_CLIENT_ID/DEV_BFF_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET GitHub secrets (and, to prove AC-02/AC-03 end-to-end, the five additional per-identity secret pairs), then a Pantheon Nonprod Deploy run succeeds past the new preflight gate and assert_bff_auth_gate passes; a scripted six-persona dev-login and negative-security-proof matrix is then run and captured against the hosted BFF.

RISK-LOOP-PROD-AUTH-001-IMAGE-DIGEST.containment: git SHA, environment, and (after redeploy) build_time still identify the deployed build precisely; image_digest is a secondary identity field, but AC-04's statement explicitly names image digest as a required identity field, so its absence is recorded as blocking per independent review rather than a secondary/non-blocking gap.
RISK-LOOP-PROD-AUTH-001-IMAGE-DIGEST.description: image_digest has no source anywhere in this repo's build pipeline: images are built locally on the VM via 'docker compose up -d --build' and never pushed to a registry, so there is no OCI registry digest. Populating this field requires a follow-up change that captures the local image ID via 'docker inspect' after build and re-injects it as BFF_IMAGE_DIGEST, which was out of scope for this fix.
RISK-LOOP-PROD-AUTH-001-IMAGE-DIGEST.recheck_trigger: Implement the build+inspect+redeploy sequence and observe /bff/version report a non-'unknown' image_digest live.
